moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio rim-glow, written here): Looping rim light on a dark silhouette (r 50 disc): stroke 2 → 4 → 2 px and outer glow 10 → 22 → 10 (drawn as a shadow blur of 0.8× that: 8 → 17.6 px), 1000 ms per cycle (sine ping-pong, 500 ms each way); a 1 px outer ring at radius + stroke and up to 50 % opacity follows the peak; the inside stays dark. Params: stroke (2 → 4 px) · glow (10 → 22) · period (1 s) · color.
